source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Say, O Messenger: He is Allah, uniquely singular in divinity and lordship; none shares with Him in His names and attributes.
tafsir.muyassar-2: Allah, Who is perfect in attributes of honor, glory and majesty, to Whom creation turns to fulfil their needs and desires.
tafsir.muyassar-3: He has no child, no father, and no consort.
tafsir.muyassar-4: And none among His creation is like Him or resembles Him — not in His names, nor His attributes, nor His acts. Blessed and exalted is He.
